args.question: Please provide the cardholder statement on whether they recognise and authorised this transaction, and any prior account activity.

args.narrative: The transaction of 18321 USD was authorized (auth code 389817) with AVS Y and CVV M. Account activity and prior undisputed transactions on the account are attached (prior transaction ids cd-5009-000000-p1, p2, p3). A delivery proof (USPS, delivered 2026-01-18) and the receipt for the same amount are attached. The merchant does not hold a device and IP match record for this transaction, so this response does not claim one. The cardholder states they do not recognise the charge.

args.explanation: Seed 5009. Reason 10.4 (card-absent fraud), 18321 USD. Read AVS/CVV match, authorization record, account activity, prior undisputed history, delivery proof and receipt. No device/IP match record was held, and the narrative says so. Represented on 2026-03-06; the case went to pre-arbitration with a 2500 network fee at that step. The issuer accepted on 2026-03-16 and the chargeback was reversed. Ledger: chargeback 18321 debited and reversed 18321; chargeback fee 1500 and pre-arbitration fee 2500 charged and not reversed. Merchant balance 14321. No refund issued.
